title: Sitges walking tour
text: The tour was well organized. Narration was starting exactly when I reached the place that was described. It was fun, informative, yet - not overwhelming. Recommend to anybody visiting Sitges. Will explore the other tours from this web site.
author: Masha S

title: Awesome
text: First time using an online self guided tour, great value. Fantastic way to learn and explore a location at your own pace. Was easy to get side tracked but the technology worked great and very easy to follow the route. It would pick up where you left off if you stopped along the way which was great.  Wasn’t too long to become boring and info was well presented. Also liked that you could go back and re-listen. Well worth it !
author: 839karynr

title: Great walking tour
text: The tour hit highlights of Sitges and was just the right amount of walking and climbing stairs for us. We chose to do it later in the day when it was a little cooler. Some of the statutes are explained along with the history. We found it informative.
author: Mary M

title: Great Experience.
text: The audio and directions on the self guided tour were awesome. The guide was witty and fun to listen to and kept the tour interesting.
author: J5184CJchrisb

title: Brilliant!
text: Brilliantly done! So simple to use - and very well presented by John. Exactly what we’d hoped for. Just enough insight of recent and far off history
author: David_L

title: Spot on!
text: Really interesting and brilliantly presented by John. Exactly what we were looking for. Just enough insight into the past both far off and recent.
author: Davidlloyd1

title: Saxman Indian Village
text: A great tour of Saxman Indian Village by our tour guide Gavin H. Gavin was very knowledgeable of how totem poles are made and the stories behind each of them. Informative and entertaining dance display.
author: 434rossj

title: A lot of history
text: A very interesting tour with an easy to listen to tour guide. The app is geo-aware and that made it very easy to use. It was a very pleasant experience and I will be looking for other products from this vendor.
author: Robert_M

title: So Great!
text: Fabulous walking tour that got us to an area we would not have found and it was our favorite!  Interesting history I would never have known.
author: Rhonda I

title: Fantastic
text: Excellent! See the beautiful Sitges on your own time. Wonderful orator, easy to use app. Clear concise and good length of time to walk!
author: 487Barrie_Ont
